mainTopic: Offerings that go entirely to the מזבח or entirely to the כהנים, and the three placements of oil for מנחות made in a כלי
overview: The amud opens by finishing a question: does the לאו of ״כליל תהיה״ cover anything that must be burned completely, or only the מנחת כהן? רב אהרן answers from a ברייתא of רבי אליעזר that it covers everything that must be burned completely. A new משנה then gives two mirror lists. Three מנחות go entirely to the מזבח, and שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים go entirely to the כהנים. The גמרא tests each list against other offerings, such as the עולה, the bird עולה, נסכים, the bird חטאת and the מצורע's oil. It shows why each one does not belong on the list. It also explains what the משנה's word 'בזו' comes to exclude in each half. Another משנה teaches that מנחות made in a כלי need three placements of oil. It records a מחלוקת between רבי and the חכמים about when the oil is mixed, and explains that wafers are smeared in an X shape. רב פפא says the oven-baked מנחה is excluded from the three placements. A ברייתא then starts deriving these oil rules from the פסוקים, and its גזירה שוה continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Asking about the prohibition of 'it shall be offered in its entirety'
steps.stepSummary: The questioner says the other prohibition is not his question. His real question is whether the לאו of ״כליל תהיה״ applies here.
steps.simpleTranslation: That is not what I am asking. What I am asking about is the prohibition of 'it shall be offered in its entirety.' What is the law?
steps.whatsHappening: The questioner explains exactly what his doubt is. He is unsure whether the לאו of ״כליל תהיה״ applies beyond the מנחת כהן written in the פסוק.
steps.deeperAnalysis: He sets aside the other prohibition that was raised before, because he has no question about it. His real doubt is narrow. The פסוק says ״כליל תהיה״ about a כהן's מנחה, so does that ban on eating extend to other parts that must be burned completely, like the אימורים?

keyTerms.meaning: I am not asking about that (it is clear to me)
What I am really asking about is...
A negative commandment (a 'do not')
'It shall be offered in its entirety' (ויקרא 6:16), said about a כהן's מנחה

phrases.english: I am not asking about that;
phrases.notes: He means the other, simpler prohibition that was mentioned just before this.

phrases.english: when I do ask,
it is about the prohibition of 'it shall be offered in its entirety': what is the law?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues a question that began before this section by stating exactly which prohibition is in doubt.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Does the לאו of ״כליל תהיה״ apply to other items that must be burned completely, beyond the מנחת כהן?

steps.title: רב אהרן answers from a ברייתא of רבי אליעזר
steps.stepSummary: רב אהרן quotes רבי אליעזר: anything that falls under ״כליל תהיה״ carries a לא תעשה against eating it.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב אהרן said to רבינא: Come and hear, for it is taught in a ברייתא: רבי אליעזר says, anything that is under 'it shall be offered in its entirety' — the verse comes to give a prohibition against eating it.
steps.whatsHappening: רב אהרן answers the question with a ברייתא. רבי אליעזר says the ״כליל תהיה״ prohibition applies to everything that must be burned completely.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The words 'כל שהוא' (anything that is) widen the rule beyond the one מנחה named in the פסוק. So any item that must be fully burned, such as the אימורים, is covered by this לאו. That means a כהן who eats it breaks this prohibition.

keyTerms.meaning: Anything at all that is (in this category)
A negative commandment
Eating it
To give / to place (here: to attach a prohibition)

steps.whatToRemember: According to רבי אליעזר, ״כליל תהיה״ is a general לאו against eating anything that must be burned completely, not only the מנחת כהן.

phrases.english: Rav Aharon said to Ravina:
Come and hear, for it is taught in a baraita:
Rabbi Eliezer says:
Anything that is included in 'it shall be offered in its entirety,'
the verse comes to place a prohibition on eating it.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב אַהֲרֹן לְרָבִינָא: תָּא שְׁמַע דְּתַנְיָא
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question from step 1 using a ברייתא.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Yes. Any item that must be burned completely falls under the לאו of ״כליל תהיה״, so eating it is forbidden.

steps.title: משנה: offerings that go entirely to the altar
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists three מנחות that are burned completely on the מזבח, with nothing given to the כהנים.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: The meal offering of priests, the meal offering of the anointed priest, and the meal offering of libations go to the altar, and nothing of them goes to the priests. In this, the altar's power is greater than the priests' power.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It names three מנחות that go entirely to the מזבח, with no share for the כהנים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Most מנחות are split: a small part (the קמיצה) is burned and the rest is eaten by the כהנים. These three are different, because the whole מנחה is burned. The משנה describes this as the מזבח having a 'stronger hold' on them than the כהנים do.

keyTerms.meaning: Our משנה
A meal offering brought by an ordinary כהן
The anointed כהן, which means the כהן גדול
The flour offering that comes with the libations of an animal offering
The power (claim) is stronger

phrases.english: MISHNA:
The meal offering of priests, and the meal offering of the anointed priest,
and the meal offering of libations go to the altar,
and there is nothing of them for the priests.
And in this, the power of the altar is greater
than the power of the priests.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה, unrelated to the previous question.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מנחת כהנים, מנחת כהן משיח and מנחת נסכים are burned completely on the מזבח; the כהנים get nothing.

steps.title: משנה: offerings that go entirely to the priests
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists two bread offerings that the כהנים eat entirely, with nothing burned on the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: The two loaves and the showbread are eaten by the priests, and nothing of them goes on the altar. In this, the priests' power is greater than the altar's power.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives the opposite list. These two bread offerings go entirely to the כהנים, and none of them is burned on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The two lists mirror each other. שתי הלחם (of שבועות) and לחם הפנים (the bread on the שולחן) are eaten by the כהנים in full. Here the כהנים have the 'stronger hold.'

keyTerms.meaning: The two loaves of new wheat brought on שבועות
The showbread: twelve loaves placed on the שולחן each שבת
Are eaten

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה has two mirror lists. Three מנחות go fully to the מזבח, and two breads (שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים) go fully to the כהנים.
steps.confusionAlert: Don't confuse לחם הפנים with the frankincense placed next to it. The frankincense is burned, but the משנה is talking about the bread itself, which the כהנים eat entirely.

phrases.english: The two loaves and the showbread
are eaten by the priests,
and there is nothing of them for the altar.
And in this, the power of the priests is greater
than the power of the altar.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the משנה with the opposite list.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים are eaten entirely by the כהנים; nothing goes on the מזבח.

steps.title: Why isn't the burnt offering on the list?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks whether the משנה's first list is complete. The עולה is also burned on the מזבח, so it should have been listed.
steps.simpleTranslation: גמרא: And is there nothing else? But there is the burnt offering!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the משנה's first list. The עולה is burned on the מזבח, so why wasn't it included?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה seems to give a complete list of things that go fully to the מזבח. An עולה is also burned completely, so the list looks like it is missing an item.

keyTerms.meaning: And is there nothing more? (Is the list really complete?)
But isn't there...!
A burnt offering, burned on the מזבח

phrases.english: GEMARA:
And are there no others?
But there is the burnt offering!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the completeness of the משנה's first list.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's list of things that go entirely to the מזבח
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An עולה is burned on the מזבח, so it seems it should have been listed.

steps.title: The burnt offering's hide goes to the priests
steps.stepSummary: The עולה is not 'nothing for the כהנים,' because its hide is given to them.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is its hide for the priests.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the עולה doesn't fit the list. The כהנים receive its hide.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה's list is only for offerings where the כהנים get absolutely nothing. The עולה's meat is burned, but the hide goes to the כהנים, so it does not qualify. It is still an עולה; it just isn't 'entirely for the מזבח.'

keyTerms.meaning: Its hide (skin)

phrases.english: There is its hide, which goes to the priests.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 5.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The עולה goes entirely to the מזבח.
steps.terutzMaskana: The כהנים get the עולה's hide, so it doesn't belong on the list.

steps.title: What about the bird burnt offering?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks about a bird עולה, whose skin is not given to the כהנים.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there is the bird burnt offering!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא pushes further with a bird עולה. The hide answer from step 6 does not work for a bird.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A bird עולה has no hide given to the כהנים, so the previous answer fails here. It seems to go entirely to the מזבח and should have been listed.

keyTerms.meaning: A bird brought as a burnt offering

phrases.english: But there is the bird burnt offering!
phrases.notes: A bird's skin isn't given to the כהנים, so the hide answer from before doesn't help here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge that gets around the answer of step 6.
steps.kashyaTarget: The completeness of the משנה's list, after the hide answer
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A bird עולה has no hide for the כהנים, so it seems to go fully to the מזבח.

steps.title: The bird's crop and feathers are not burned
steps.stepSummary: Even a bird עולה is not burned completely, because its crop and feathers are removed.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is the crop and the feathers.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that parts of the bird עולה, its crop and feathers, are not burned on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: These parts don't go to the כהנים either; they are taken off and not offered. But since the bird is not burned in its entirety, it is not like the משנה's מנחות, where everything goes on the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: The crop of a bird (the food pouch in its throat)
Feathers

phrases.english: There is the crop and the feathers.
phrases.notes: These are removed and not burned on the מזבח, so the bird isn't fully burned.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 7.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: A bird עולה goes entirely to the מזבח.
steps.terutzMaskana: Its crop and feathers are not burned, so it isn't fully for the מזבח.

steps.title: What about wine libations?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks about wine נסכים, which seem to go entirely to the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there are the libations!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges again with wine נסכים. All of the wine is poured out and nothing goes to the כהנים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Wine נסכים have no hide and no removed parts. All the wine is poured out, so they seem to belong on the משנה's list.

keyTerms.meaning: Wine libations poured at the מזבח

phrases.english: But there are the libations!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A third challenge to the completeness of the list.
steps.kashyaTarget: The completeness of the משנה's list
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Wine נסכים are poured out entirely with no share for the כהנים.

steps.title: Libations go down to the drainpipes
steps.stepSummary: Wine נסכים are not counted as 'for the מזבח,' because the wine runs down into the שיתין (pits under the מזבח).
steps.simpleTranslation: They go to the drainpipes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the wine doesn't really go on the מזבח. It flows down into the שיתין.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה's list is for things actually placed and burned on the מזבח. The wine is poured and drains away into the pits below, so it isn't counted as 'למזבח' in the משנה's sense. This closes the challenges, and the משנה's list stands.

keyTerms.meaning: The pits or drainpipes beneath the מזבח where the wine flowed
They go

steps.whatToRemember: The משנה's list is only for offerings placed entirely on the מזבח with nothing for the כהנים. The עולה (hide), bird עולה (crop and feathers) and נסכים (drainpipes) each fail that test.

phrases.english: They go to the drainpipes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 9 and closes this series of questions.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Wine נסכים go entirely to the מזבח.
steps.terutzMaskana: The wine drains into the שיתין, so it isn't counted as placed on the מזבח.

steps.title: What is the word 'בזו' coming to teach?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the משנה stresses 'בזו' ('in this case') when it says the מזבח's share is greater than the כהנים' share.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what is the point of the word 'in this'?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why the משנה says 'בזו', 'in this case.' This question sets up the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says 'בזו', meaning 'in these items' the מזבח's share is greater. That sounds like it is ruling out some other item that we might have thought goes entirely to the מזבח. The גמרא wants to know which item that is.

keyTerms.meaning: 'In this', the משנה's word marking the cases where the מזבח gets everything
The 'power' or share of the מזבח

phrases.english: And what is meant by 'in this'?
phrases.notes: This points to the משנה's line: 'In this, the power of the מזבח is greater than the power of the כהנים.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After settling that wine נסכים go to the שיתין, the גמרא asks what the משנה's word בזו excludes.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What case does the משנה's emphasis 'בזו' come to exclude?

steps.title: The word 'בזו' rejects שמואל's view on donated wine
steps.stepSummary: The word comes to reject שמואל, who said donated wine is sprinkled on the fires. Instead, it goes down to the שיתין.
steps.simpleTranslation: It comes to exclude the view of שמואל. שמואל said: one who donates wine brings it and sprinkles it on the fires. The משנה teaches us that it goes down to the שיתין.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that 'בזו' comes to reject שמואל's ruling about wine that a person donates. The משנה teaches that such wine goes into the שיתין and is not burned on the fire.
steps.deeperAnalysis: שמואל held that donated wine is treated like a קרבן that is burned: it is sprinkled onto the fires of the מזבח. The משנה's wording shows that this is wrong. Donated wine is poured like נסכים and runs down into the שיתין.

keyTerms.meaning: 'To exclude', to rule out a certain view or case
One who donates something on his own (a נדבה)
He sprinkles it
The fires on the מזבח
'This teaches us', the new point being made

phrases.english: To exclude the view of שמואל,
as שמואל said:
One who donates wine brings it
and sprinkles it on the fires.
It teaches us
that it goes to the שיתין.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 11.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: בזו excludes שמואל's view. Donated wine goes to the שיתין and is not sprinkled on the fires.
steps.whatToRemember: Wine, whether נסכים or donated, goes down to the שיתין. That is why it is not counted among the items 'for the מזבח' in the משנה.

steps.title: The משנה supports שמואל on donated oil
steps.stepSummary: The משנה supports שמואל's ruling that from donated oil, a קמיצה is taken and the rest is eaten.
steps.simpleTranslation: This supports שמואל. שמואל said: one who donates oil takes a handful from it, and the rest is eaten.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא points out that the משנה backs up a different ruling of שמואל, about oil that a person donates.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה does not list donated oil among the items that go entirely to the מזבח. This fits שמואל's ruling: only a handful (קמיצה) of the oil is offered, and the כהנים eat the rest.

keyTerms.meaning: 'It supports him', a source that backs up someone's view
He takes a handful (קמיצה) from it
The leftovers after the קמיצה, eaten by the כהנים

phrases.english: This supports שמואל,
as שמואל said:
One who donates oil takes a handful from it,
and its leftovers are eaten.
phrases.notes: The support comes from what the משנה leaves out: donated oil is not on its 'all for the מזבח' list.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After rejecting one view of שמואל, the גמרא shows the same משנה supports another of his rulings.
steps.raayaObject: שמואל's ruling that donated oil has a קמיצה taken and the rest is eaten.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The משנה, which leaves donated oil off its list of items that go entirely to the מזבח.

steps.title: Does a bird חטאת also go entirely to the כהנים?
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists only שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים as going entirely to the כהנים. The גמרא asks: what about a bird חטאת?
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים go entirely to the כהנים. Are there no others? But there is the bird חטאת!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the second half of the משנה. It challenges the list by pointing to a bird חטאת, which the כהנים eat and none of which is burned on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה presents שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים as the only items the כהנים eat with nothing going to the מזבח. A bird חטאת seems to fit that description too, so the list looks incomplete.

keyTerms.meaning: The two loaves brought on שבועות
The bread placed each week on the שולחן
'And there are no more?', a challenge that a list is missing items
A bird brought as a חטאת

phrases.english: The two loaves and the showbread,
phrases.notes: This quotes the משנה: these are eaten by the כהנים, and none of them goes on the מזבח.

phrases.english: and there are no more?
But there is the bird sin-offering!

steps.triggerLanguage: וְתוּ לֵיכָּא? וְהָא אִיכָּא חַטַּאת הָעוֹף
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new set of challenges on the second half of the משנה (step 4). It works like steps 5, 7 and 9, which challenged the first half.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's list of items that go entirely to the כהנים.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A bird חטאת is eaten by the כהנים and is not burned on the מזבח, yet the משנה does not list it.

steps.title: The bird חטאת's blood goes on the מזבח
steps.stepSummary: A bird חטאת is not entirely for the כהנים, because its blood is put on the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: There is its blood.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that the מזבח does get a share of the bird חטאת: its blood.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even though no meat is burned, the blood of the bird חטאת is sprinkled on the מזבח. So the מזבח gets something, and the משנה rightly leaves it off the list.

keyTerms.meaning: Its blood

phrases.english: There is its blood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 14.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Shows that the case does not fit the category: the מזבח does get a share.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The bird חטאת seemed to go entirely to the כהנים.
steps.terutzMaskana: Its blood is placed on the מזבח, so it is not entirely for the כהנים.

steps.title: Does the מצורע's לוג of oil go entirely to the כהנים?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the list again: the לוג of oil of a מצורע seems to go entirely to the כהנים.
steps.simpleTranslation: But there is the לוג of oil of a מצורע!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second item that seems to belong only to the כהנים: the לוג of oil that a מצורע brings when he becomes טהור.
steps.deeperAnalysis: None of the מצורע's oil is burned on the מזבח, and the כהנים eat what is left. So it seems it should be on the משנה's list next to שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים.

keyTerms.meaning: The measure of oil a מצורע brings on the day of his טהרה

phrases.english: But there is the log of oil of a leper!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the bird חטאת is answered, a new example is brought against the same list.
steps.kashyaTarget: The משנה's list of items that go entirely to the כהנים.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The מצורע's oil is not burned on the מזבח and is eaten by the כהנים, yet the משנה does not list it.

steps.title: The מצורע's oil has its applications
steps.stepSummary: The oil is not entirely for the כהנים, because some of it is used for the sprinklings and placings in the מצורע's service.
steps.simpleTranslation: There are its applications.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers that some of the oil is used in the service: it is sprinkled before ה׳ and put on the מצורע's body. So not all of it goes to the כהנים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Oil is sprinkled seven times before ה׳ and placed on the מצורע's right ear, thumb and big toe. Because part of the oil is used for a holy service, it is not counted as going entirely to the כהנים.

keyTerms.meaning: Its applications: the sprinklings and placings of the oil

steps.whatToRemember: An item counts as 'all for the כהנים' only if nothing of it is used for the מזבח or for a service before ה׳. Blood on the מזבח, or oil sprinkled before ה׳, takes an item off the list.

phrases.english: There are its applications.
phrases.notes: See ויקרא 14:16-17: oil is sprinkled seven times before ה׳ and put on the מצורע's ear, thumb and toe.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 16.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Shows that the case does not fit the category: part of the oil is used in a service.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The מצורע's oil seemed to go entirely to the כהנים.
steps.terutzMaskana: Part of the oil is used for sprinklings and placings, so it is not entirely for the כהנים.

steps.title: What does the word 'in this' add?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the משנה stressed the word 'בזו' when it said the כהנים have more power than the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: And what is the point of the word 'in this'?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks why the משנה needed the extra word 'בזו'. The answer comes in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה said that with שתי הלחם and לחם הפנים, the כהנים get everything and the מזבח gets nothing. The word 'בזו' (in this) sounds extra, so the גמרא asks what it comes to teach.

keyTerms.meaning: 'In this': the משנה's word stressing this specific case

phrases.english: And what is meant by 'in this'?
phrases.notes: This points back to the משנה's line: 'in this, the power of the כהנים is greater than the power of the מזבח.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After defending the משנה's list against two challenges, the גמרא now asks about a specific word in the same line.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: What extra teaching does the word 'בזו' bring?

steps.title: Even loaves brought alone still go to the כהנים
steps.stepSummary: The word 'בזו' rejects the view that שתי הלחם brought without their lambs are burned. It teaches that the כהנים always get them.
steps.simpleTranslation: It comes to reject the one who says that שתי הלחם brought by themselves are burned. It teaches us that in this case the power of the כהנים is always greater.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא explains that 'בזו' teaches that the כהנים always eat the שתי הלחם, even when they are brought without the lambs.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Some held that שתי הלחם brought without their two lambs cannot be eaten and must be burned. The גמרא reads the משנה's word 'בזו' as rejecting that view: in this case the כהנים' power is always greater. Either way, the loaves belong to the כהנים, never to the fire.

keyTerms.meaning: To exclude or reject a view
The two loaves brought on שבועות
By themselves, without the accompanying lambs
Burning
It teaches us

steps.whatToRemember: שתי הלחם always go to the כהנים, even when brought without their lambs.

phrases.english: To exclude the view of the one who says:
The two loaves that are brought by themselves
phrases.notes: He means without the two lambs that are normally brought together with them.

phrases.english: go to be burned,
it teaches us
that in this case the power of the priests is always greater.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 18.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: 'בזו' teaches that the כהנים always eat the שתי הלחם, rejecting the view that loaves brought without lambs are burned.

steps.title: Three oil placements for meal offerings made in a vessel
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה: every מנחה prepared in a כלי needs three placements of oil.
steps.simpleTranslation: All מנחות prepared in a כלי need three placements of oil: pouring, mixing, and putting oil into the כלי before preparing them.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It teaches that מנחות made in a כלי (like a pan or deep pan) need oil put in three times.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The three placements are listed backwards. First oil goes into the כלי, then it is mixed into the flour, and last it is poured on top after cooking.

keyTerms.meaning: מנחות prepared in a vessel (pan or deep pan)
Pouring oil on top
Mixing oil into the flour
Putting oil into the vessel first

steps.confusionAlert: The משנה lists the three steps in reverse order. In practice the oil goes into the כלי first and the pouring comes last.

phrases.english: MISHNA: All the meal offerings that are prepared in a vessel,
require three placements of oil:
pouring, and mixing,
and placing oil in the vessel before their preparation.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins a new משנה on a new topic.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מנחות prepared in a כלי need three oil placements: oil in the כלי, mixing, and pouring.

steps.title: When is the oil mixed in: loaves or flour?
steps.stepSummary: רבי says the oil is mixed in after the flour is baked into loaves. The חכמים say it is mixed into the flour itself.
steps.simpleTranslation: Loaves: one mixes them with oil. That is רבי's view. The חכמים say: the fine flour is mixed.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה records a מחלוקת about when the בלילה (mixing) happens.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי holds you bake first, then break the loaves and mix in the oil. The חכמים hold you mix the oil into the raw סולת before baking.

keyTerms.meaning: Loaves
He mixes them (with oil)
Fine flour

phrases.english: Loaves, one mixes them; this is the statement of Rabbi.
phrases.notes: He means you mix in the oil after the flour is already baked into loaves.

phrases.english: And the Rabbis say: fine flour.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains how the בלילה from step 20 is done, and records a dispute about it.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי: mix oil into the baked loaves. חכמים: mix oil into the raw flour.

steps.title: Wafers are smeared in an X shape
steps.stepSummary: Loaves need mixing, but רקיקין need smearing in an X shape. The leftover oil is eaten by the כהנים.
steps.simpleTranslation: Loaves need mixing, and wafers need smearing. How does he smear them? In the shape of a chi (X). The rest of the oil is eaten by the כהנים.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה contrasts loaves with wafers and describes how the wafers get their oil.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Wafers are not mixed with oil. Instead oil is smeared on them in an X shape after baking. Any oil left over is not wasted; the כהנים eat it.

keyTerms.meaning: Thin wafers
Smearing oil on top
In the shape of the Greek letter chi (X)

phrases.english: The loaves require mixing,
and wafers require smearing.
How does one smear them? In the shape of a chi,
phrases.notes: Chi is a Greek letter shaped like an X.

phrases.english: and the rest is eaten by the priests.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the משנה, moving from loaves to wafers.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Wafers are smeared with oil in an X shape, and the leftover oil is eaten by the כהנים.

steps.title: What do the words 'made in a vessel' exclude?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks which מנחה is left out by the משנה's words 'prepared in a vessel'.
steps.simpleTranslation: To exclude what?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks what the משנה meant to leave out when it said 'מנחות prepared in a כלי'. The answer comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Saying 'in a כלי' suggests that some מנחה does not get the three oil placements. The גמרא wants to know which one.

keyTerms.meaning: To exclude

phrases.english: GEMARA: To exclude what?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: The גמרא begins discussing the new משנה from step 20.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which מנחה is excluded by the phrase 'הנעשות בכלי'?

steps.title: The oven-baked offering is excluded
steps.stepSummary: רב פפא answers that the phrase excludes the מנחת מאפה, which is baked in an oven and not made in a כלי.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב פפא said: to exclude the oven-baked מנחה.
steps.whatsHappening: רב פפא answers that the משנה is leaving out the מנחת מאפה תנור.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The מנחת מאפה is baked in an oven, not prepared in a pan, so it does not count as 'made in a כלי'. That means it does not get all three oil placements.

keyTerms.meaning: The meal offering baked in an oven

steps.whatToRemember: Only מנחות made in a כלי get all three oil placements. The oven-baked מנחה is excluded.

phrases.english: Rav Pappa said:
To exclude the baked meal offering.
phrases.notes: This is the מנחה baked in an oven, so it is not prepared in a vessel.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַב פָּפָּא לְמַעוֹטֵי מִנְחַת מַאֲפֶה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 23.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The phrase excludes the מנחת מאפה, which is baked in an oven rather than made in a כלי.

steps.title: A פסוק teaches that the מרחשת needs oil placed in the vessel
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא learns from the פסוק of the מנחת מרחשת that oil must be put into the vessel before the flour.
steps.simpleTranslation: The רבנן taught: The פסוק says, 'And if your offering is a deep-pan meal offering, it shall be made of fine flour in oil.' This teaches that it needs oil to be put into the vessel.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא to give a source for the oil placements the משנה described. It starts with the מנחת מרחשת, the deep-pan offering.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says 'סלת בשמן,' which means flour in oil. The ברייתא reads this to mean the oil is already in the pan and the flour is added on top of it. That is the first of the three placements of oil, called מתן שמן בכלי.

keyTerms.meaning: The deep-pan meal offering
Fine flour
Putting oil into the empty vessel before the flour
It teaches. This is how a ברייתא shows what a פסוק is coming to tell us

steps.whyThisMatters: This gives a source in the תורה for the first of the three oil placements mentioned in the משנה in Step 20.

phrases.english: The Sages taught:
"And if your offering is a deep-pan meal offering,
it shall be made of fine flour in oil"
This teaches that it requires
placement of oil in a vessel.
phrases.notes: The oil goes into the empty pan first, and the flour is added afterward.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״וְאִם מִנְחַת מַרְחֶשֶׁת קׇרְבָּנֶךָ סֹלֶת בַּשֶּׁמֶן תֵּעָשֶׂה״, מְלַמֵּד
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the question of which מנחה the משנה left out (Steps 23-24) to finding a source in the תורה for the oil placements.
steps.raayaObject: The rule that a מנחה made in a כלי needs oil placed in the vessel first
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא 2:7, 'סלת בשמן תעשה' said about the מנחת מרחשת

steps.title: Starting a גזירה שוה from the word 'your offering'
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא points out that the word 'קרבנך' appears both by the מרחשת and by the מחבת. It uses this to set up a גזירה שוה.
steps.simpleTranslation: The word 'your offering' here and the word 'your offering' there are for a גזירה שוה:
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is setting up its next move. It announces a גזירה שוה between the מרחשת and the מחבת, and what we learn from it comes on the next amud.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The same word 'קרבנך' is written by the מרחשת (ויקרא 2:7) and by the מחבת (ויקרא 2:5). A matching word like this lets us carry a rule from one offering over to the other. The ברייתא has not yet said which rule moves across. That comes on the next amud.

keyTerms.meaning: A teaching based on the same word appearing in two places, so a rule from one place carries over to the other
Your offering. This is the word shared by both פסוקים
The pan (griddle) meal offering

steps.confusionAlert: This line is not finished yet. It only announces the גזירה שוה. What it actually teaches comes on the next amud.

phrases.english: "Your offering," "your offering"
phrases.notes: One is in the מרחשת פסוק (ויקרא 2:7), and the other is in the מחבת פסוק (ויקרא 2:5).

phrases.english: are for a verbal analogy:

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the ברייתא from Step 25 by linking the מרחשת and the מחבת so that a rule can pass between them.
steps.raayaObject: Carrying the oil rules over between the מרחשת and the מחבת
steps.raayaSupportSource: The shared word 'קרבנך' in ויקרא 2:5 and 2:7
